notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Financial figures are from the FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0000831001-26-000011, filed February 20, 2026); ownership is from the 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A filed April 2, 2026, accession 0001206774-26-000185). LEADER: Jane Fraser, CEO since 2021, was also elected Chair of the Board in October 2025 (2026 proxy). She beneficially owned 332,827 shares at March 23, 2026, less than 1% (the proxy states no director or executive officer owned more than 1%), so pctEconomic is null. Her total-ownership column of 935,831 adds 603,004 shares of deferred receipt, which are not counted as beneficially owned. HOLDERS: Vanguard's row still relies on a Schedule 13G/A filed February 13, 2024 (the proxy adds that Vanguard later reported an internal realignment and will report on a disaggregated basis); BlackRock's on one filed April 24, 2025. The proxy gives only filing dates, so asOf is null. DIVIDENDS: the cash-flow statement reports one 'Dividends paid' line covering common and preferred dividends ($5,372 million). The 10-K separately says 'In 2025, Citi repurchased $13.3 billion of common shares and paid $4.3 billion of common dividends'; the equity statement shows common dividends of $4,340 million and preferred dividends of $1,114 million declared. BUYBACKS: 'Treasury stock acquired' of $13,250 million is common stock (it includes shares withheld for employee taxes under stock programs, per footnote 3); the $5,000 million redemption of preferred stock is excluded. STOCK COMP: null. Citi does not state one company-wide share-based compensation expense. Its incentive compensation cost table (Note 7, total $2,259 million in 2025) mixes stock and cash awards: charges for estimated awards to retirement-eligible employees $819 million (stock and cash), amortization of deferred cash awards, deferred cash stock units and performance stock units $254 million, immediately vested stock award expense $29 million, amortization of restricted and deferred stock awards $758 million, option expense $1 million, other variable incentive compensation $398 million. The related income tax benefits for stock-based compensation were $447 million. Summing the stock lines would be a derivation, so the value is left null. PLAN: no employee stock purchase plan is described in the 10-K. GEOGRAPHY: 'North America' primarily reflects the U.S.; Corporate/Other (largely U.S. activities and intersegment eliminations) was negative in 2025 (−$1,082 million) and is left out of segments because a segment cannot be negative, so North America and International sum to 86.31 against the stated total of 85.23; U.K. revenues were about $7.6 billion within International (10-K footnotes). AFTER YEAR END: Citi signed and closed the sale of AO Citibank, its former Russian subsidiary, on February 18, 2026 (10-K).
